title: Save spindump output to a file
summary: Instead of printing to the terminal, save the spindump report to a text file. This is useful for sharing the report with support or analyzing it later.

steps.explain: Run spindump for a specific process and use the -o flag to write the output to a file path you choose.

placeholders.name: PROCESS_NAME_OR_PID
placeholders.description: The name of the application or its Process ID (PID).

placeholders.name: OUTPUT_FILE_PATH
placeholders.description: The full path where you want to save the report.

steps.expect: The command completes without printing the report to the screen. The file is created at the specified path.
